review_reference: UNSIGNED: for the owner (D-Eminence) to approve and sign. 0122 seeds the OCR worker's workload account (subject hid:staging:ocr-worker, source_system hid-workload, no email, no password) and gives it the platform ocr_worker role (0013; grants only ocr.job.process) outside auth.admin_change_platform_role, which refuses that role (0064), as 0105 did for the document scanner. The owner's approval of that seed, quoted here with its date, is required before reviewed_by is filled.
evidence: Single migration 0122_ocr_worker_account.sql. WHY: since the OCR worker started, production's Postgres logs show ocr.claim_worker_job(text,integer) (0014, replaced by 0105) refused about 4 times a minute with 42501 Authorized OCR workload context is required (4 Nov 21:40 UTC): the worker sets app.actor_subject from OCR_WORKER_SUBJECT, and no auth.accounts row holding the platform ocr_worker role exists for any subject. No migration, release step or admin command on any branch creates one. WHAT IT DOES: inserts exactly two rows, the account 0c4e0122-0122-4000-8000-000000000001 (subject hid:staging:ocr-worker, display name OCR worker, active) and its role row 0c4e0122-0122-4000-8000-000000000002 (platform ocr_worker, granted_by null, grant_reason naming migration 0122), ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING followed by exact-row checks. No function, policy, table, grant or runtime-grants.sql change; no patient data read or written; no audit row (a dry run would consume audit.events' sequence). Preconditions (55000 or 42501, nothing applied): 0105 applied (ehr.resolve_document_scan_target is the marker); not already applied (else 0122: already applied); auth.account_id_for_subject md5 4678770cf6a210034740f09422fdfbaa and auth.account_has_active_role md5 a3310b48da6ff8bcd3ecb9d7dbef900a (the pins 0105 uses); ocr.claim_worker_job still calls both for ocr_worker; the columns written; ocr_worker active and granting exactly ocr.job.process; the applier may read and insert both tables and execute both helpers. A post-check runs the worker's own test for the new subject. THE FIX NEEDS TERRAFORM TOO: the worker only starts claiming after OCR_WORKER_SUBJECT is changed on dev (infra/terraform/modules/application/workloads.tf, today identity_subjects["ocr"] = hid:staging:ocr-api) to "hid:${local.workload_identity_environment}:ocr-worker" and the worker restarts; apply it after this release. Until then the worker answers 42501 exactly as today. Claims will still return no job until the document scanner is live, because a claim takes only jobs whose document's latest scan is clean (0105) and production runs no scanner. Kill switch, no release needed: revoke the role row or set the account's status to disabled. ORDER: verify-release-contract refuses a missing migration prefix, so this file can only be released after 0106 through 0121 are on the branch (they are claimed by other work); on that rebase components.json, the ledger test and the ledger take their rows, this file needs no change (it pins nothing they replace), and this declaration must name only the migrations still pending on production. PROOF on a throwaway PostgreSQL 16.15 cluster run as pgrun (never a real database): a 0105 database built by f11c9ec9's runner and bootstrapped with its runtime-grants.sql reproduces production's refusal (42501 for hid:staging:ocr-api as hid_ocr_worker). UPGRADE: plan 1 pending; dry run rolled back with no account or role row; apply 16 ms; then 0 pending, the runner again 0 pending, the file again answers 0122: already applied; 1236 non-owner grants before and after, identical md5 (e82d05f38f5e567cc73bd15941f85d86), the bootstrap and --verify-only pass and change none. FRESH install of all 107 files (dry run leaves no ledger table, apply, re-run 0 pending, already applied; same 1236 grants) and a MIGRATION_TARGET=rds fresh install. As hid_ocr_worker with the worker's session: hid:staging:ocr-worker claims (0 rows with no job; the new suite claims its fixture job and writes one ocr.worker.claim audit row naming the worker account), while hid:staging:ocr-api, a random hid:staging:<uuid>, an empty subject, the scanner's subject and a near-miss subject still get 42501, as do the seeded subject with its role revoked or its account disabled. A NOSUPERUSER NOBYPASSRLS owner of every object applies it; a login without privileges is refused (42501) with nothing applied. Negative copies each refuse with nothing applied: 0105 missing, the subject held by another account, the seeded id present, an extra ocr_worker permission, ocr_worker inactive, a changed helper body, a claim that no longer checks ocr_worker, a changed column. Locks before commit: ROW EXCLUSIVE on auth.accounts and auth.account_roles, ROW SHARE on auth.accounts and auth.roles, ACCESS SHARE on those and auth.role_permissions and identity.sealed_demo_members; nothing on ocr.jobs, ehr.documents or audit.events. All 80 database suites pass on the upgraded, fresh and rds databases (79 existing and the new test/database/ocr-worker-account.integration.sql), which also passes on the re-owned database. verify-migration-ledger passes 107 migrations (0122 last).
